title: Explicit deterministic Miller-Rabin under the quasi-Riemann hypothesis
summary: Make the witness bound W(n)=(C ln n + D)^(1/(1-theta)) for deterministic Miller-Rabin fully explicit, assuming a zero-free half-plane Re s > theta for Dirichlet L-functions, and minimize C.
